headline: Passage and Strand Flare as Expanse Falls Quiet
war_summary: Since the evening edition activity has shifted north and west while the southern storm has eased. The Weathered Expanse, heaviest on the day with 36 changes, records none in the last two hours at two Warden and seven Colonial holdings, with Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk last named. Palantine Berm now leads the active list with five changes in two hours, eleven in six and nineteen on the day at five Warden, one Colonial and one unheld about The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni. Kuura Strand counts three in two and fourteen on the day and now stands six Warden holdings with none Colonial or unheld about Suosalo, Talven and Menneen. Callahan's Passage adds three in two and thirteen on the day at nine Warden to one Colonial about Crumbling Post. The Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet in the last two hours though seventeen and twenty-seven stand on the day, while Mooring County shows heavy losses without fresh changes.
